sources.name: Wikipedia contributors — 2026 NFL season (selected games)
sources.changes: Selected 19 explicitly dated regular-season highlights: opener, nine international games, five Thanksgiving-week games and four Christmas-week games. Expanded team labels, generated stable selection IDs, and normalized venue-local calendar dates. Omitted kickoff clocks, article prose, images, results, and all other matchups. Melbourne remains September 11 locally, with the source's September 10 U.S. date explained. Away/home team identities retained as named game participants.
